treatment: existing validated Jev root move ordering; no pruning or evaluator changes

clock.searchClockStarts: immediately before the common analyze call, after request preparation, response validation, and persistence

openings.generation: independent new trajectories, phase drawn with probability 0.5 for each of 32 openings; uniform or capture-prioritized generation, no AI score filtering
openings.selection: nonterminal; target phase; 2..255 legal variants; existing request size limit; exclude known historical states, duplicates and a legal immediate win not caused by relay-limit

execution.warmup: fresh baseline/candidate engines per game; same initial state depth 2, outside clocks; identical warmup after process restart
execution.forcedMove: no API call; retain in game and outcome
execution.checkpoint: every request attempt, valid response and committed move
execution.normalPause: finish and checkpoint current move, then pause; resume same position and schedule

responses.missingUsage: retain maximum reservation; a valid answer may be used; report unresolved cost
responses.secondFailure: stop study as technically incomplete; preserve game; no third attempt under this protocol

outcomes.winLoss: only valid terminal outcome in frozen rule engine
outcomes.anyMissingOutcome: INCOMPLETE; no confirmatory decision; retain every planned game

statistics.unit: two games from one opening with candidatePlayer reversed
statistics.primary: two-sided exact binomial sign test on 2-0 versus 0-2 pairs
statistics.null: conditional probability of a Jev 2-0 pair among non-tied pairs is 0.5
statistics.tiedPairs: 1-1 pairs retained in score, contribute no direction to sign test
statistics.confidenceInterval: 95% exact binomial interval for q=pair_2_0/(pair_2_0+pair_0_2); NOT a per-game win-rate interval
statistics.superiorityRequires: all64 valid terminal outcomes, no unresolved integrity/clock deviations, p<=0.05 and corresponding sign
statistics.missingOutcomeScoreBounds: [W/64, (W+U)/64] descriptive possible-score bounds, NOT confidence interval
